2) Process I will follow: we receive a redline set from Acme -> I upload to shared Drive and tag the redlines by category (Legal / Security / Product / Ops) -> For Legal/Security we aim for 48 business-hours; Product/Ops will be estimated per item but I'll assign an expected turnaround when I triage.

- Priority areas: data residency, audit logs retention, and breach notification timing. If Redwood can indicate a preferred fallback position (e.g., standard 30-day log retention vs. 90-day), it will help speed decisions.

1) Naomi to publish the edit-tracker by EOD today and add initial ETA column.
2) Acme to deliver consolidated redline file by 2027-11-12 EOD.
3) Redwood to respond to consolidated redlines with an annotated MSA within the proposed SLA windows; escalate to Evelyn as needed.
